title: Aliens have visited humanity for a very long time

tellings.quote: several times. Um my impression was that they've been here for a very long time.

plain: Aliens have been coming to Earth for a very long time, and many times over. That is the impression of a former Army sergeant named Dan Sherman, who says the National Security Agency, the US government's signals spy agency, hired him in the early 1990s to communicate with aliens. He tells it as something he came to understand through that work, and if true it would mean visits are old, not new.
